text:
Estimate the quantities from the photo.

Almonds: I count roughly 45 on the plate. At about 1.2 g each, that is about 54 g, or about 310 kcal at 579 kcal per 100 g.

Cherry tomatoes: there are about 10 red ones, including the one by the almonds, at about 15 g each, so about 150 g.

Grapes: there are about 11 red grapes at about 5 g each, so about 55 g.

The tomatoes and grapes together weigh about 205 g. The tomatoes add about 27 kcal (150 g at 18 kcal per 100 g) and the grapes about 38 kcal (55 g at 69 kcal per 100 g).

Total energy is about 310 + 27 + 38 = 375 kcal. Total mass is about 54 + 150 + 55 = 259 g.
